record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded domain in ℝⁿ. Write λ₂(Ω), …, λₙ₊₁(Ω) for the second through (n+1)-st Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues of Ω, and Λ₁(Ω) for the lowest buckling eigenvalue. Is the stronger lower bound Λ₁(Ω) ≥ (1/n)(λ₂(Ω) + ··· + λₙ₊₁(Ω)) always true?

evidence.quote: It is interesting to note that if (45) could be improved to Λ₁(Ω) ≥ (1/n)(λ₂(Ω) + ··· + λₙ₊₁(Ω)), then this together with (26) (Problem 8 above) would prove (44).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain. Consider the Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalue problem
$$-\Delta u = \lambda u \text{ in } \Omega, \qquad u=0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega,$$
whose eigenvalues, counted with multiplicity, are $0<\lambda_1(\Omega)\le \lambda_2(\Omega)\le \lambda_3(\Omega)\le \cdots$. Consider also the buckling (clamped-plate) eigenvalue problem
$$\Delta^{2} v = -\Lambda\,\Delta v \text{ in } \Omega, \qquad v = \frac{\partial v}{\partial \nu}=0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega,$$
whose smallest eigenvalue is denoted $\Lambda_1(\Omega)$.

Decide whether the inequality
$$\Lambda_1(\Omega) \;\ge\; \frac{1}{n}\bigl(\lambda_2(\Omega) + \lambda_3(\Omega) + \cdots + \lambda_{n+1}(\Omega)\bigr)$$
holds for every bounded domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface related work on Payne–Pólya–Weinberger-type universal inequalities and on the Payne conjecture relating buckling and Dirichlet eigenvalues, but none of the located sources establish or disprove the specific stronger lower bound $\Lambda_1(\Omega)\ge\frac{1}{n}\sum_{k=2}^{n+1}\lambda_k(\Omega)$. The status of this strengthened bound therefore appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: The Payne conjecture for Dirichlet and Buckling eigenvalues
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the Payne conjecture relating buckling eigenvalues to Dirichlet eigenvalues but does not address the specific sum bound.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures linking buckling and Dirichlet eigenvalues remain an active topic; this particular strengthened inequality is not stated as established.

status_evidence.title: Inequalities for eigenvalues of the buckling problem of arbitrary order
status_evidence.snippet: Universal inequalities for higher buckling eigenvalues are derived but the precise lower bound (1/n) sum_{k=2}^{n+1} lambda_k is not asserted.
status_evidence.claim: No evidence that the proposed strengthened lower bound has been proved.
